audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] says 'Blind his Q-pull attempts with Blinding Shot to remove his only reliable gap-close'. Blinding Dart suppresses basic attacks. Bear Trap on a Rope is an ability and is completely unaffected by blind, as is Jousting (E).
audit.why: This tells the player to hold Q for the hook, which is exactly the wrong reflex — Q is wasted and the hook still lands. The ability blind actually blanks is Violent Tendencies (W), which is literally four basic attacks.
audit.corrected: Blind blanks Violent Tendencies (W). It does nothing to Bear Trap on a Rope (Q), Jousting (E) or Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (R).
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (W: 'gains massive attack speed for four attacks'; Q/E/R are ability damage)

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] (the Lvl 2-3 card) and 'early' both state Kled's Q cooldown is 7 seconds. Bear Trap on a Rope is 11/10/9/8/7 — 7s is rank 5, which needs level 9.
audit.why: In the exact phase the card describes, the real window is 11s or 10s. The advice understates Teemo's free time by 3-4 seconds per cycle, which is the difference between one poke and two.
audit.corrected: 11s at rank 1, 10s at rank 2. 7s only from level 9.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'mid' claims that at levels 4-5 you have 'max-rank Blinding Shot' and 'mushrooms at the tribush and river bush'.
audit.why: Q rank 5 requires level 9 and Noxious Trap is the ultimate, so Teemo has no mushrooms at all before level 6. Both describe an impossible board state.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5: Q rank 3 at best and zero mushrooms. The lead comes from range discipline only.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer repeatedly says 'mounted W-joust', conflating two different abilities: W is Violent Tendencies (attack speed, four attacks) and E is Jousting (the dash).
audit.why: The distinction is the whole matchup: blind stops W and does nothing to E. Merging them into one name hides the only interaction that matters.
audit.corrected: Violent Tendencies (W) = the autos blind eats. Jousting (E) = the 550-range dash blind cannot touch, recastable to dash back out.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Bear Trap on a Rope only yanks if the shackle is held for a short duration, or that Move Quick is the counterplay to it.
audit.why: Teemo has no dash. The trap is escapable by distance, and Move Quick's bonus speed is explicitly 'not stopped by being struck' — that is the tool.
audit.corrected: The trap yanks only if you stay shackled. Move Quick out of range and it deals its base hit and nothing else.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (Q: 'If shackled for a short duration, the target ... is yanked toward Kled')

audit.whatIsWrong: The two layers disagree on the level chart. content win = [Kled, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Skill, Kled]; full phases sides = [Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Teemo]. They disagree at Level 1, Levels 4-5, Level 6, First item and Two+ items.
audit.why: The two layers render on the same page. Level 6 in particular is Teemo in one and Skill in the other. The content layer also contradicts itself: 'mid' calls levels 4-5 'your command window' while win[3] says Skill, and 'late' says the first-item window is yours while win[5] says Skill.
audit.corrected: Aligned the two internally-contradictory content stages (4-5 and first item) to Teemo, matching both the full layer and the content layer's own prose. Left Level 1 and Two+ items alone: I have no basis to pick a side there and the strings are different lengths anyway.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] ('Kite his Q pull') and dontsFull[1] ('Let him remount') carry descriptions lifted from unrelated template slots — neither describes its own heading.
audit.why: 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown' says nothing about Skaarl remounting.
audit.corrected: Give each heading its own mechanic: the shackle duration for the pull, and courage-from-damage for the remount.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kled.json (P: 'Kled can restore Skaarl's courage by fighting enemies')

edits.before: Kled's mounted Q Beartrap can grab you before your blind is up — stay at max auto range and do not step close enough for the pull.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope throws 800 against your 680 Q, so he opens from outside your range — hold max auto range and never sit in the shackle.

edits.before: Once Blinding Shot is level 2 and poison stacks are live, every Kled Q cooldown is a 7-second window to poke him and rebuild distance safely.
edits.after: Once Blinding Dart is up and poison is live, each missed Bear Trap buys you 11s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 2 — not the 7s he only reaches at level 9.

edits.before: Kled's R Chaaaaarge!!! charge pairs with finished Sundered Sky or Black Cleaver to run you down — shrooms delay him but cannot stop a fed Kled reaching you.
edits.after: Kled's R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! pairs with a finished Sundered Sky or Black Cleaver to run you down; at 140/125/110s it is rare, but shrooms only delay a fed Kled.

edits.before: Blind his Q-pull attempts with Blinding Shot to remove his only reliable gap-close
edits.after: Blank Violent Tendencies (W) with Blinding Dart — those four attacks are autos

edits.before: Land Beartrap on a Rope before Blinding Shot is up to stick to you and remove your kite
edits.after: Land Bear Trap on a Rope from 800 range and hold the shackle to yank you into Jousting

edits.before: With Blinding Shot online every trade flips: his autos miss during the blind, you poison him and W back out, and his Q pull is the only thing keeping him relevant.
edits.after: Blinding Dart blanks Violent Tendencies — four autos, all wasted — but it never touches Bear Trap on a Rope or Jousting, so you kite the abilities and blind only the auto window.

edits.before: Both champions have kill threat if they land their key ability first: his Q Beartrap into W-joust vs your Q blind into poison kite — neither decisively controls the window.
edits.after: Bear Trap on a Rope is 10-9s here and you still have no shrooms until 6, but your 680 range plus Move Quick beats a Kled with one entry tool — this is a control window, not a coin flip.

edits.before: Liandry's Angueur DoT pressures his HP through Skaarl's tether, mushrooms lock down the split lane, and he cannot burst you faster than you poison him — but neither side dominates cleanly.
edits.after: Liandry's DoT pressures him through Skaarl's health pool, mushrooms lock down the split lane, and Sundered Sky is not online yet — this window is yours before his item spike arrives.

edits.before: Kled level 1 is the one window where the matchup flips against you — his Beartrap on a Rope has real range and if it lands before Blinding Shot is up he pulls you into a full mounted W-joust you cannot survive. Stay at the very tip of auto range and do not walk forward until you have Q. The moment you hit level 2, the matchup swings hard: Blinding Shot blanks every auto Skaarl throws, his W-joust deals no damage while blind is active, and your E poison starts ticking. Poke, W back out, repeat. At level 3 you have the full poke loop and he has no reliable way to stick to you through Move Quick — trade freely when his Q Beartrap is on cooldown (7 seconds), and never let him bait your blind before his commit.
edits.after: Kled level 1 is the one window that flips against you — Bear Trap on a Rope throws 800 against your 680 Q, so he opens from outside your range and if the shackle holds you are yanked into Violent Tendencies. Stay at the tip of auto range. From level 2 the trade maths change, but be precise about why: Blinding Dart blanks Violent Tendencies, because those four attacks are basic attacks. It does nothing to the trap itself and nothing to Jousting, which is a 550-range dash he can recast to leave again. So blind the autos, not the engage. Poke, Move Quick out, repeat, and count his trap: 11s at rank 1, 10s at rank 2 — a long free window each time he misses.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your command window. Max-rank Blinding Shot on a 7-second cooldown means Kled's mounted auto DPS is near zero in any trade he initiates, and your mushrooms at the tribush and river bush deny his flanking angles while revealing whether his team is setting up a dive. At level 6 Noxious Trap accelerates your zone control — drop mushrooms along his R charge line so he cannot path toward you in stealth, and if he uses Chaaaaarge!!! you see the route and can W away before he arrives. Track Skaarl's courage bar: if he has been poke-forced to low courage, that is your kill window — he cannot remount quickly if you kill Skaarl first and keep poison ticking.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your control window, but on range and Move Quick alone — Q is rank 3 at best and you own no mushrooms until 6, because Noxious Trap is the ultimate. Bear Trap on a Rope sits at 10-9s and Jousting at 12-11s; those two cooldowns are the whole clock. From 6, drop mushrooms on the flanking angles and on his Chaaaaaaaarge!!! approach so his route is revealed and slowed before he arrives. Track Skaarl's courage: Kled rebuilds it by dealing damage, so a Kled you refuse to let touch anything stays dismounted — and dismounted he deals reduced damage to champions and trades his trap for Pocket Pistol, a ranged blast that shoves him backwards away from you.

edits.before: Blind his autos — kite his pull, shroom dismount. Teemo wins the Beartrap on a Rope cooldown windows.
edits.after: Blind his autos — kite the pull, shroom his dismount. Teemo wins the Bear Trap on a Rope windows.

edits.before: Q-blind erases his auto-trade window entirely. Only take the trade when Kled's Beartrap on a Rope is down.
edits.after: Q-blind blanks Violent Tendencies, not his Q or E. Trade when Bear Trap on a Rope is down — 11s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Beartrap on a Rope's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: Bear Trap on a Rope is 10-9s here and you own no shrooms until 6. Bank leads on range and Move Quick alone.

edits.before: - Kled Beartrap on a Rope: matchup-defining — His engage hook. Blind + kite it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kled Bear Trap on a Rope 11/10/9/8/7: matchup-defining, and blind does NOT stop it. - Jousting 13/12/11/10/9: his other entry and his exit, also immune to blind. - Violent Tendencies 13-9s: blind this one.

edits.before: Kled wastes Beartrap on a Rope — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: The trap only yanks if you stay shackled — Move Quick out of range.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Kled rebuilds courage by dealing damage — deny him targets, not HP.

notes: CHAMPION-WIDE NAME DEFECTS on Teemo, all needing one global replace rather than per-matchup proposals: (1) Teemo's Q is written "Blinding Shot" 271 times in champ-data/content/teemo.js — real name Blinding Dart. (2) Kled's Q is written "Beartrap on a Rope" 26 times in champ-data/teemo.full.js and "Beartrap" 7 times in content/teemo.js — real name is "Bear Trap on a Rope" (two words). Zero correct spellings exist in either file. (3) Kled's R is written "Chaaaaarge!!!" 4 times in content — the real name is "Chaaaaaaaarge!!!" (eight a's). (4) "Liandry's Angueur" appears 80 times in content/teemo.js and is not an item name; teemo.full.js uses "Liandry's Torment". I only fixed instances inside strings I was already editing for substance. ALSO: the two layers disagree on this matchup's level chart at five of seven stages (see audit point 2) — worth a systematic cross-layer chart check on Teemo, not just this entry.
